note: Derived reading aid. Never authoritative; never read as intent (Decision 0004). The Plan document governs.
author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Repair the planning route's review findings
purpose: Two reviews of the planning agent route found a defect in how the model binding is passed, a model-selection document that contradicts the code, and a proposal that cannot yet be answered. This Plan fixes those in a governed draft. The planning route itself stays unplanned until the operator answers the revised proposal.
serves: The Project outcome of accurate model choice and of proposals the operator can decide on.
done_when: The spawn step passes the recorded model and effort to the coding agent process, the model-selection document matches the code, and the proposal is revised so the operator can answer it.

actions.title: Pass the chosen model settings to the spawned coding agent
actions.why: The record claims a model the spawned process never receives, which makes runs misleading.
actions.done_when: A test shows the spawned command includes the binding's model and effort flags, and the displayed, saved and spawned commands all agree.

actions.title: Make the model-selection document match the code
actions.why: A document that names only two places to choose a model misleads anyone who chooses another way.
actions.done_when: The document names the binding registry as a place to choose a model and states which setting wins when a plan and a binding disagree.

actions.title: Revise the planning route proposal so it can be answered
actions.why: The operator cannot make a sound decision from a proposal that names the wrong input channel.
actions.done_when: The proposal names the channel the launched session actually reads, and its validation changes keep older planning artifacts passing.
